description: We are Spectral Frontier, a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for space science and technology. We enjoy exploring challenging questions, turning ideas into innovative solutions, and learning together. We welcome curious minds with skills in coding, research, design, data analysis, or storytelling who want to collaborate, experiment, and push the boundaries of discovery with us.
summary: Our project is "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars" A story time which is about NASA's discarded Equipment on moon and mars which will create curiosity about space among children and students.
details: Its a one scroll website, Content in website is educational and will help kids and students develop interest in space and technology. Html CSS is used.
